title: Juicy Shaggy Turkish Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Turkish dish featuring lamb, cranberries, and a blend of spices, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a traditional tagine pot. This low-fat-friendly recipe is served with toast for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the dried cranberries and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the lamb and sauce over whole wheat toast.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
